name: Assent of Snow
source:
At a quiet town at the end of the year, Gaige finds himself an opportunity to spend time with a girl. Is this a date? A chance to get to know her better? Will it go as smoothly as planned?

[From [url=https://elleran.itch.io/assent-of-snow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
年底，在一个安静的小镇，盖奇发现自己有机会和一个女孩共度时光。这是约会吗？有机会进一步了解她吗？事情会像计划的那样顺利吗？

[来自[url=https://elleran.itch.io/assent-of-snow]Itch.io[/url]]
